incident-bot: Incident created • HIGH — embeddings.service / eu-dedicated-2 — elevated 5xx (>15%) — Customer impact: Nightingale Health (enterprise). Pager: @oncall-robert
Robert: I'm on it. Gathering logs and tailing pod logs.
Ana-SRE: Restarting embedding-worker pool on eu-dedicated-2 (rolling). Command: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/emb-worker -n inference-eu`. Starting now.
incident-bot: Action queued: restart started by Ana-SRE.
Robert: Observing OOM traces in emb-worker-7: `java.lang.OutOfMemoryError`. Scaling replicas +2 and increasing pod memory limit for this release.
Mike-Platform: Drafting tailored customer note for Nightingale. ETA question: how long until stable?
Elly-CS: Need a concise message for their PM + security. Confirming no data loss and what the visible impact is for users.
Mike-Platform: Draft (please review): "We are currently investigating an increased error rate on embedding requests hitting your eu-dedicated-2 capacity. Our engineers have initiated a rolling restart and are scaling the worker pool; you may see intermittent 5xx responses for some requests. No data loss is suspected. We will provide updates every 30 minutes or as the situation changes. Primary contacts: Elly (CS), Robert (On-call SRE)."
Sara-Status: Posted interim status to status.redwood.ai/incidents/1767009999 — included timeline, affected regions, mitigation steps. Also emailed the Nightingale security contact with the draft.
Robert: After restart + scale: 5xx rate dropped to ~2%. KV cache warm-up ongoing. Monitoring for 30m; will hold on-call until 22:00 UTC then hand to night-shift.
Elly-CS: Sending the tailored message to their PM + integrations lead now (cc security). Will include incident link and expected follow-ups. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Update logged: mitigation partial-success. Monitoring. Next automated update scheduled in 30 minutes.
